description: The system shall allow the partner to consult the list of their clients.
The system shall display a list of clients with basic data.
The user shall be able to filter and sort the client list.
The user shall be able to select a client to view their locations.
The system shall allow the partner to consult the list of locations for a selected client.
The system shall display a list of locations with their respective players.
The system shall allow the partner to create a new location for a client.
The system shall provide a form for creating a new location and use the Google Maps API to facilitate address searching.
The system shall allow the partner to initiate the registration process of a player by scanning a QR code.
If the QR code is valid, the system shall navigate to screens for selecting the client and location.
The system shall allow the partner to consult the status of a player.
The system shall display the current status and last connection time for each player in the location list.
The system shall allow the partner to perform real-time actions on a player.
The system shall provide buttons to restart, shut down, force synchronization, and restart playback.
The system shall allow the partner to receive push notifications.
If the user has notification permissions enabled, they shall receive push notifications in case of incidents.
The system shall allow the partner to change their password.
The password must have a minimum of 8 characters, one uppercase letter, one number, and one special character.
The application must be simple to use for any user.
The application must always be available to the user.
The application must ensure that user data is confidential and protected from unauthorized access.
The application must be available for mobile devices with iOS and Android systems.
The application must be compatible with English, French, German, Catalan, Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian.
